about.name: Lyna Kezzal
about.subtitle: About Me
about.description:
I am a Computer Science student from Algeria and an aspiring UI/UX Designer and Front-End Developer.

I enjoy transforming ideas into intuitive digital products through thoughtful design and clean development.

Alongside my university studies, I continuously improve my skills by building personal projects, creating Figma interfaces, coding responsive websites, and collaborating on agency work.

I believe the best way to learn is by building real projects, challenging myself, and continuously improving every day.

I am particularly interested in creating modern interfaces that combine usability, aesthetics, and performance.

I expect to graduate with my Bachelor's degree in Computer Science in 2027.

uiUxVideos.description: A smart environmental analysis application designed to evaluate soil conditions before construction.
